segments.text: Its trilinear distances are directly proportional to the side lengths, a, to b, to c, which makes X six the unique point inside triangle A B C that minimizes the sum of the squares of the perpendicular distances to the three sidelines. Its barycentric sub-triangle areas are proportional to the squares of the sides, a squared, to b squared, to c squared. On the central lines layer, X six anchors the Brocard axis through X three, X fifteen, and X sixteen.
